_comment: PUNK Multiverse dedicated coordinator. CUSTOM Wine image (not stock steamcmd) - PUNK is a Steam playtest and cannot be fetched by SteamCMD; the operator supplies the game files. See pelican_egg/README.md.
name: PUNK Multiverse
author: omarsanchezdev@gmail.com
description: Dedicated headless coordinator for PUNK Multiverse (the co-op mod for PUNK). Runs the Windows game under Wine with the LiteNetLib 'Udp' transport - no Steam required. Game files are operator-supplied (PUNK is a Steam playtest, not SteamCMD-downloadable).

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
# PUNK Multiverse install script.
#
# Nothing to install here: the base game AND BepInEx are baked into the server image, and the mod
# self-updates from GitHub on boot. This step runs in a separate installer container that has no
# access to the image's baked files, so it just prepares the data directory and exits.
set -e
mkdir -p /mnt/server
echo "Nothing to install: the base game + BepInEx are baked into the server image, and the mod"
echo "self-updates from GitHub on boot. The game is copied into place on first start."
echo "Install step complete."

variables.name: Mod Auto-Update
variables.description: 1 = on every boot, check GitHub releases and install a newer mod build if available. 0 = keep whatever is already installed.

variables.name: Mod Version
variables.description: Which mod release to run: 'latest' (default) or a specific release tag like v0.1.131. Pin a tag to freeze the server on a known build.

variables.name: Mod Release Repo
variables.description: GitHub owner/repo the mod is pulled from. Leave as default unless you fork the mod.

variables.name: GitHub Token
variables.description: Optional. A GitHub token to lift API rate limits or pull from a private mod repo. Not needed for the public repo.

variables.name: Install BepInEx
variables.description: 1 = overlay the image's baked BepInEx loader onto the game each boot (makes a vanilla game copy mod-ready and keeps the loader version consistent). 0 = use the game copy's own BepInEx.

variables.name: Game Executable
variables.description: Windows executable to launch, relative to the game directory.

variables.name: Game Directory
variables.description: Absolute path to the game install inside the container. Leave as default unless the files are nested in a subfolder.

variables.name: Advertised Address
variables.description: Host address written into the join code shown to players (host:port). Informational - the server binds all interfaces on the allocation port regardless. Set to your public IP/DNS to make the in-game code copy-pasteable.

variables.name: Auto-Start Run
variables.description: 1 = the coordinator launches the run automatically. 0 = the first player to join (the session admin) presses START from their in-game host controls.

variables.name: Enemy HP Scaling / Player
variables.description: Enemy max-health multiplier added per EXTRA player beyond the first (1 + value*(players-1), solo = vanilla baseline), fixed at run start. Mod config key EnemyHealthScalePerPlayer. Decimal, e.g. 0.25. Leave blank to use 0.25.

variables.name: Coin Despawn (seconds)
variables.description: How long dropped gold coins persist before expiring. Mod config key CoinDespawnSeconds. Default 45.

variables.name: Empty-Server Reset (seconds)
variables.description: If a run is in progress and no players have been connected for this many seconds, the server ends the abandoned run and returns to a fresh lobby (grace window allows crashed players to rejoin first). Party wipes reset within seconds regardless. 0 = never reset.

variables.name: Mod Version Policy
variables.description: How joiners with a mismatched mod version are handled. Reject = refuse the join (recommended). Warn = allow but log a warning.

variables.name: Admin Command File
variables.description: 1 = watch BepInEx/plugins/PunkMultiverse/devcmd.txt so an operator can inject dev/admin commands (spawn, status, roster, etc.) at runtime. 0 = disabled.

variables.name: Log Level
variables.description: Console verbosity. Verbose = full instrumentation blocks every ~3s (default: a dedicated server console is a diagnostic surface). Normal = warnings + events, instrumentation every 30s. Quiet = warnings and events only.

variables.name: Sync Diagnostics
variables.description: 1 = verbose [Diag] sync/authority logging (useful when debugging desync). 0 = quiet.

variables.name: Stop Grace (seconds)
variables.description: On Stop, seconds to wait for the game to flush its save and exit cleanly before Wine is force-killed.

variables.name: Steam App ID
variables.description: PUNK Playtest appid, written to steam_appid.txt so the base game does not relaunch through the Steam client. Change only if the playtest appid changes.

variables.name: Wine Debug
variables.description: WINEDEBUG channel setting. Default -all (silent). Use e.g. +err,+warn to diagnose Wine issues.

variables.name: Extra Launch Args
variables.description: Additional arguments appended to the Punk.exe command line (Unity/Punk flags).

variables.name: Enable Game Modes
variables.description: Master switch for alternate game modes. 0 = every run is the normal co-op game and the Game Mode setting below is ignored. Set to 1 to allow Battle Royale.

variables.name: Game Mode
variables.description: Ruleset for runs this server hosts (requires Enable Game Modes = 1). BattleRoyale = last ship standing: scattered spawns at pre-opened stations, PvP with reduced damage, a lava ring closing over the match, supply drops, and placement screens.

variables.name: BR: Match Minutes
variables.description: Battle Royale only. Total match length; the lava ring finishes closing exactly at this mark, so this is also the match timer.

variables.name: BR: Ring Start Minutes
variables.description: Battle Royale only. Minutes of grace before the ring's first closure.

variables.name: BR: Ring Stages
variables.description: Battle Royale only. How many closures the ring makes. The zone holds still between them.

variables.name: BR: Ring Close Seconds
variables.description: Battle Royale only. How long a single closure takes. Shortened automatically if a stage is too brief to fit it.

variables.name: BR: Care Package Minutes
variables.description: Battle Royale only. Minutes between supply drops (0 = none). Only the player who destroys a drop gets its loot.

variables.name: BR: PvP Damage Scale
variables.description: Battle Royale only. Multiplier on player-vs-player damage, so late-game weapons cannot one-shot other players. Damage to enemies is unaffected.

variables.name: BR: Enemy HP Scale
variables.description: Battle Royale only. Enemy health multiplier. 0.5 means players effectively deal double damage to enemies, so kills and gold come twice as fast.

variables.name: BR: Minimum Players
variables.description: Battle Royale only. Players required to START a match. 1 is allowed for testing.
